exposure: timing of fetal cardiac scan (13+0-13+6 weeks vs. 16 weeks)
maternal BMI (low BMI <25 vs. high BMI >=25)
outcome: adequate assessment rate of fetal cardiac scan
cohort: The study included 100 pregnant women at low risk of congenital heart anomalies, divided into groups based on low or high body mass index.
finding: Early fetal echocardiography at 13+0-13+6 weeks is feasible and accurate, demonstrating a significantly higher adequate assessment rate compared to examinations at 16 weeks, particularly for high BMI women using the transvaginal approach.
cross-section timing: Fetal cardiac scans were performed at 13+0-13+6 weeks and at 16 weeks gestation.
